$comment: /projects/ — the catalogue of what teams built, each from content/projects (none yet: the first come from the Oct 13 Showcase, with the teams' consent). The empty state says so by the clock: before the next Showcase, when it's coming; after, that projects appear once their teams agree.

meta.need: As someone deciding whether this is real, I need to see what teams have built, so that I can judge the work and find people to learn from.

title: Projects
description: What teams built in a Build Cycle: real problems, working prototypes, findings, and the people behind them.

hero.title: What teams made.
hero.lede: Every Build Cycle ends at a Showcase, where each team shows what it built: a prototype, a finding, a tool, what worked and what didn't. Anyone can use it, and the team's names stay on it.

empty.before: The first projects go up after the {title} Showcase on {showcase}.
empty.after: Projects appear here once their teams have agreed to be shown.

how.title: A problem, a team, twelve weeks.

steps.title: A problem situation
steps.body: Each cycle starts with real, messy problems people face, brought by the people who face them.

steps.title: A Pod, then a team
steps.body: Nine or more people gather round a problem; teams of three to five form round the ideas worth making.

steps.title: The Showcase
steps.body: Every team shows its work in public. What's reusable goes back to the commons, with credit.

project.$comment: Words for a project's own page.

join.title: Make one.
join.lede: Make your free account, then apply for the next Build Cycle from there.
